source_text: Θεομάχος, φησίν, κληθήσεται ὁ τὴν ἐλαχίστην τῶν ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ἐντολῶν ἀθετῶν. διὸ καὶ ἀθετεῖται παρὰ θεοῦ ὡς αὐτῷ ἀνθιστάμενος καὶ ἀντινομοθετῶν.
pass_a_gloss: God-fighter, he says, will be called the the least of the in the law commandments setting-aside. Wherefore also he is set-aside beside God as to him opposing and counter-legislating.
pass_b_english: Whoever sets aside the least of the commandments in the law will be called a God-fighter, he says. That is why he is also set aside by God, as one who opposes him and legislates against him (Matthew 5:19).

choices.why: Strong Cyril label for antinomian repeal.
